description: This file is a shell script that provides an interoperability testing framework for version control systems, primarily focusing on git. It includes functions for building specific git versions, creating wrapper scripts, and setting up test environments, relying on sourcing other configuration and test script files.

methods.name: build_version
methods.description: Builds or retrieves a specific version of git, identified by a version specifier or a special symbol like '.', and manages build directories.

methods.name: wrap_git
methods.description: Creates a wrapper script to emulate certain functionalities of git, especially for old versions lacking features.

methods.name: generate_wrappers
methods.description: Generates wrapper scripts for git commands to facilitate interoperability testing.
